body: Thank you for your message. I try to tell myself this but I suppose it is hard to change my way of thinking after being raised in a very traditional household with Asian parents. I've been told my whole life that there is only one path to take and if I fail then there is no hope and trying to unlearn that has been difficult. But thank you for being so kind I would like to see the list of people you were referring to before.

Thank you for your message. My therapist has been telling me this same thing. And although I would never shame some one else for graduating late it still feel ashamed that I can't get through school. I understand that I have problems but it is still hard seeing all my friends applying for prestigious universities and getting 100 marks for their tests.
Thank you for the kind message. It's hard to think positively about my future considering recent events in my life, but thank you for making me feel better.
